_source: GitLab ciConfig merged response for getplumber/examples/go-test-with-hash, captured 2026-08-27 via the platform's /context.
_why: Evidence for the #286 normalisation assumption. The project's own .gitlab-ci.yml writes the third include as `$CI_SERVER_FQDN/getplumber/plumber/plumber@<sha>`; GitLab returns it here already resolved to `gitlab.com/...`. That is what lets the hash computed over the UNMERGED config agree with the hash computed over this merged response - the agreement #286 restored. If GitLab ever stopped resolving server-side, include inputs would be dropped and an overridden component job would be misreported as hardcoded.
